findings.issue: Debounce timer not cleared on unmount; fires after navigation and router.replace's the user back to '/'
findings.suggestion: Clear searchTimer in onBeforeUnmount (and skip the push if route is no longer '/')

findings.issue: Any fetch failure (500/network) renders the Not-found page because only data?.found is checked and useFetch's error is ignored; same pattern on pokemon/ability/type pages
findings.suggestion: Distinguish error from 404: surface useFetch's error ref or have endpoints return 200 with found:false for 404 and use error boundaries for real failures

findings.issue: Page-payload functions return Promise<any|null> and callbacks annotate everything as any; the server/app data contract is untyped
findings.suggestion: Export an interface per page payload and use useFetch<PokemonPage>(…) / typed defineEventHandler in the API routes

findings.issue: setResponseStatus(404) uses the deprecated no-event overload
index.species.find() linear scan per entry inside learned-by/ability/type loops (O(n*m))
findings.suggestion: Build a Map<number, SpeciesSummary> by id once alongside the index

findings.issue: typeLabel Map construction duplicated four times; displayNumber/isMissing also duplicated in MoveTables.vue and moves/[name].vue
findings.suggestion: Extract a typeLabelMap() helper and a shared isMissing/displayNumber util

findings.issue: Failed /api/app/dex fetch shows 'No Pokémon found' / '0 Pokémon' rather than an error state
findings.suggestion: Branch on the error/status ref and render a retryable message

findings.issue: watch: [game] is redundant since the reactive query object already triggers refetch
compatibilityDate '2025-07-15' predates the pinned Nuxt 4.6.3; no lint/typecheck dev tooling in the project
findings.suggestion: Bump compatibilityDate to the current date and add a typecheck script

summary: A genuinely idiomatic Nuxt 4 app: correct app/ structure, server routes, reactive useFetch and URL-driven state, with clean server/client separation and careful accessible markup. The main merge blockers are an unmounted debounce timer that can hijack navigation, systematic conflation of fetch errors with 404s, and an any-typed data contract that undermines the framework's typing story. All fixable in one focused round of changes.
